name: Bièvre
text: The Bièvre (French pronunciation: [bjɛvʁ]) is a 34.6-kilometre (21.5 mi) long river of the Île-de-France région that flows into the Seine (left bank) in Paris.

depictions.name: Bievre
depictions.text: Bièvre (river) The Bièvre is a 36 kilometre-long river that flows into the Seine in Paris. During the 18th century, the Bièvre was of great economic importance, with numerous tanneries and workshops built alongside its banks. The river was used as a dumping ground and became severely polluted as a result.
